ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New accounts, Identified and later stages need Opportunity type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_accounts", CASE(StageName, "Identified", 1, "First contact", 2, "Needs confirmed", 3, "Sample or trial", 4, "Quote issued", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Closed won", 7, 0) >= 1, ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity_type__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Opportunity type before moving to Identified.
